delivery_contract.value: exact original UTF-8 journal envelope bytes including final newline
delivery_contract.content_hash: envelope_sha256 plus sha256 of the complete raw line
delivery_contract.ordering: all records of a run use one stable key and one partition; partition count must not change while runs are open
delivery_contract.conflict_policy: same key with different bytes or owner quarantines the whole run
delivery_contract.source_of_truth: immutable verified journal and transactional PostgreSQL outbox; broker retention is not archival retention
delivery_contract.commit_rule: consumer offset committed only after idempotent durable insertion; offset is not a chain-finality claim
delivery_contract.completion_rule: ScopeCompleted required; ChunkCompleted alone never completes the scoped scan
delivery_contract.invalidations: append and retain; never compact away or convert into a positive counter

acl_intent.note: These are reviewable intent records, not rpk input. Broker-specific idempotent-producer ACL requirements must be tested in a dedicated cluster; no cluster-wide permission is preapproved.

readiness_gates: literal resource ACL positive and negative tests
transactional outbox relay implemented and reviewed
no observer endpoints, principals, topic names or consumer groups
